purpose: compress ring and clock topology into one source-bound germ contract, then expand by n-way or fold-clone onto machine-published new acreage

expansion_contract.address_policy: preserve existing addresses; new acreage does not slide old addresses

reasoning: It directly covers the unresolved rings-and-clocks compress-then-expand requirement.
It reuses the measured shared-topology, winner-only, n-way, and fold-clone precedents instead of inventing a host compression format.
Binding future expansion to machine-published acreage and existing addresses preserves the no-invented-destination and no-remap laws.
The zero-byte-per-expanded-lane value is a design target from the winner-only precedent, not a measured result for this unbuilt organ.
